pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:0.6: Ime kho pan' ayyāyo chasaṭṭhisatā pācittiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarena upāsakena bhikkhunīsaṃgho lasuṇena pavārito hoti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.3: yāsaṃ ayyānaṃ lasuṇena attho ahaṃ lasuṇenā 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.5: sace bhikkhuniyo āgacchanti ekamekāya bhikkhuniyā dve tayo bhaṇḍike dehīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.6: tena kho pana samayena Sāvatthiyaṃ ussavo hoti,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.8: bhikkhuniyo taṃ upāsakaṃ upasaṃkamitvā etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.13: Thullanandā bhikkhunī khettaṃ gantvā na mattaṃ jānitvā bahuṃ lasuṇaṃ harāpesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.15: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo na mattaṃ jānitvā bahuṃ lasuṇaṃ harāpessantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.16: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tassa khettapālassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.18: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā Thullanandā na mattaṃ jānitvā bahuṃ lasuṇaṃ harāpessatīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.19: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave Thullanandā bhikkhunī na mattaṃ jānitvā lasuṇaṃ harāpesīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.22: hi nāma bhikkhave Thullanandā bhikkhunī na mattaṃ jānitvā lasuṇaṃ harāpessati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.23: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.25.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave Thullanandā bhikkhunī aññatarassa brāhmaṇassa pajāpati ahosi
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.28: atha kho bhikkhave so brāhmaṇo kālaṃ katvā aññataraṃ haṃsayoniṃ upapajji,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.31: atha kho bhikkhave Thullanandā bhikkhunī ayaṃ haṃso amhākaṃ ekekaṃ pattaṃ detīti taṃ haṃsarājaṃ gahetvā nippattaṃ akāsi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.32: tassa puna jāyamānā pattā setā sampajjiṃsu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.33: tadāpi bhikkhave Thullanandā bhikkhunī atilobhena suvaṇṇā parihīnā,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.39: atha kho bhagavā Thullanandaṃ bhikkhuniṃ anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā dubbharatāya --pa--
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.40: evañ ca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc1:1.41.1: yā pana bhikkhunī lasuṇaṃ khādeyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
